title: Code vs model decisions
summary: Assign exact calculations and enforceable rules to deterministic components.

sections.label: Division of work
rows: Extract possible values from unstructured passages
Assess semantic similarity of bounded candidates

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Models cannot turn an unsupported claim into approved data by expressing certainty. Every resulting action remains constrained by the controller’s rules.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended use: Allocate exact calculations and enforced invariants to code, then test the boundary with model judgments.
Use independent expected values for dates, rates and identifiers.
Show that an unsupported model result cannot bypass the action or publication guard.
Workflow placement and checks are Atlas recommendations. Existing examples, tenant availability, older product claims and comparative benefits were not revalidated by this mapping review.

catalog.applicability: Use when deciding which parts of a process a model may perform and which must stay in code, such as exact calculations, access rules, identity checks and schema validation. A model expressing certainty never turns an unsupported claim into approved data.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
